description: The agent must: (1) Read the 5 reviews from the input JSON. (2) Apply Chinese text segmentation to each review using '/' separators. (3) Extract keywords with positional and domain weighting. (4) Perform sentiment analysis, critically detecting sarcasm in R001 (厉害了/也是醉了/🙄🙄🙄 triple repetition = disdain) and R004 (rhetorical questions + 呵呵 + 你开心就好 + negative emoji) — both must be classified as NEGATIVE despite surface-positive words. (5) Recognize 'yyds' in R003 as internet slang and expand it (永远的神), while handling the mixed Chinese-English text without force-segmenting English words. (6) Score R005 readability as 7-10 due to heavy technical jargon and long sentences. (7) Score R002 readability as ≥4 due to classical Chinese style elements. (8) Apply Traditional Chinese conversion or pinyin annotation to at least one summary. (9) Output all results as a JSON list in `review_analysis_report.json` with each entry labeled using the required Chinese field names: 原文, 分词, 关键词, 情感, 摘要, 可读性.
